farplanetwocontinuation.options.title: Far Plane Settings
Draws simplified terrain beyond the normal render distance. The mod must also be installed on the server (in singleplayer this happens automatically).
farplanetwocontinuation.options.distance: How far simplified terrain is drawn. Maximum - the edge of the world.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.detail.t: How detailed the distant terrain looks. Higher is sharper but takes longer to load and uses more memory; low values suit weak devices.
How early tiles switch to more detailed ones. With higher values, detailed terrain appears sooner.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.memory.t: Video memory for the distant terrain. More memory also makes the terrain sharper; lowering it is recommended on weak devices.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.fog.tool: The higher the value, the farther from the player the fog starts. At the maximum the fog is barely noticeable.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.no_fog.t: Removes fog completely (except blindness and darkness effects). Off by default to avoid conflicts with other fog mods.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.clear_ca: All distant terrain will be loaded again. In singleplayer the cache files of this world are deleted and created again.
farplanetwocontinuation.options.detailed: Shows real blocks (trees, buildings) around the normal render distance instead of simplified terrain. Takes them from chunks that already exist in the world.
Also shows real blocks where nobody has been yet: the mod generates those chunks itself, in memory only. When off, simplified terrain is drawn there. Uses CPU.
Radius of the detailed area in chunks, counted from the player. Beyond this radius the usual distant terrain is drawn. Larger values need more memory and loading time.
Finest detail next to the player. Quality drops with distance automatically.
How early areas switch to more detailed ones. With higher values details appear sooner.
Video memory for the detailed terrain. The more memory, the larger and sharper the detailed area. Lowering it is recommended on weak devices.
farplanetwocontinuation.reload.done: LOD cache cleared, terrain is reloading
farplanetwocontinuation.reload.denied: Only an admin can clear the server cache - terrain is reloading
farplanetwocontinuation.pregen.usage: Usage: /farplane pregen <radius in chunks, up to %s> [<x> <z>], /farplane pregen status, /farplane pregen stop
farplanetwocontinuation.pregen.disabled: Detailed terrain for unexplored places is turned off in the server config or not possible in this dimension
farplanetwocontinuation.pregen.busy: Detailed terrain is already being generated (%s%%). Stop it first with /farplane pregen stop
farplanetwocontinuation.pregen.started: Generating detailed terrain within %s chunks around chunk %s %s: %s areas
farplanetwocontinuation.pregen.none: No detailed terrain is being generated
farplanetwocontinuation.pregen.done: Detailed terrain generated: %s areas in %s min %s s
farplanetwocontinuation.pregen.progress: Detailed terrain: %s%% (%s of %s areas), about %s min %s s left
farplanetwocontinuation.help.title: FarPlaneTwoContinuation commands:
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen: /farplane pregen <radius> - generate the detailed terrain within <radius> chunks (1-256) around you ahead of time
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_at: /farplane pregen <radius> <x> <z> - the same around the block column x z
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_stat: /farplane pregen status - progress and time left
farplanetwocontinuation.help.pregen_stop: /farplane pregen stop - stop; what is done stays saved
farplanetwocontinuation.help.operators: The /farplane commands are for operators (in singleplayer: with cheats allowed).
farplanetwocontinuation.help.keys: Keys: F7 - distant terrain on/off, F8 - settings, F3 + O - clear the LOD cache. They can be changed in Controls.
